description: Active voucher of the store, started, not expired, not restricted to a customer, whose remaining balance covers at least minBalance (so it pays the whole order: Amount To Be Paid 0); applied and removed, no order placed. KB: Managing Vouchers; Configuring a Voucher.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode); a voucher belongs to one store

minBalance.description: Remaining balance the voucher must have at least: above the largest order total the test builds, so the voucher pays all of it

now.description: System param: evaluation time, filled in by the profiler or resolver; tests do not set it
